cluster_summary: This cluster includes vulnerabilities where privileged operations (config changes, admin commands, profile updates) lack proper authorization checks. The code often assumes implicit trust based on the communication channel or lower-level authentication, but fails to verify that the caller possesses a required admin or owner scope, allowing lower-privilege users or prompt-injected models to perform unauthorized actions.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Add an explicit check that the sender is the owner (senderIsOwner === true) before adding the action to the exposed set and before handling it, otherwise throw an authorization error..
